mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ141. The base knee-and-kick sequence launches the opponent; additional input adds another attack, while directional input can teleport the user to the target and produce a four-hit sequence. Current dedicated documentation reports 10% total damage for the four-hit route and 12% extra damage for the additional-input route; exact timing remains unresolved.
